hotels.vendor_name: Casa de Sada Beach Resort Algarve
hotels.title: Grand Opening: Portugal Seaside Serenity in Algarve with Daily Breakfast & One-Time Dinner
hotels.description: The Algarve's hottest new opening with the best seat in the house: right by the beach, facing the Atlantic Ocean. At Casa de Sada Beach Resort, the sand is steps away and you have two pools to choose from, including a panoramic heated saltwater pool where afternoons stretch into balmy evenings. Indoors, contemporary styling gives the resort a fresh, considered feel, with ocean panoramas in many of the rooms and suites. Then there’s the food: at Palm Beach, fresh seafood is served by the shore, while Alma pairs Portuguese and North African influences with sweeping panoramas across the water. Look forward to an even deeper reset when a sparkling new spa opens in April 2027, complete with a Moroccan hammam, sauna, ice fountain and hot tub. For a change of scene, the Benagil coast is about a 20-minute drive away, where boat trips explore the Algarve’s famous sea caves. Back onsite, Âmbar offers panoramic ocean views and delectable cocktails in a modern setting.

hotels.title: Portugal: Algarve Luxury Retreat on Private Lake with Vilamoura Marina Views & Floating Restaurant
hotels.description: Set on a private lake with views across the Vilamoura marina, Domes Lake Algarve is a five-star retreat where the natural world blends with true luxury. Spend days between the pools and Praia de Falesia - one of Europe's most celebrated beaches, with direct access from the hotel plus dedicated loungers reserved for resort guests. Unwind at Soma Spa, where treatments draw on ancient Greek traditions alongside hammam rituals and wellness experiences. Five world-class golf courses are easily accessible via a complimentary shuttle. Dining is a highlight, spanning six distinct concepts: from Greek and Portuguese fusion at Gustatio and wood-fired Italian at Antonino's, to the lakeside floating experience at Blend Nikkei and Wine. Round off the evening at Migratory Bar, a champagne and cocktail lounge where every drink tells its own story.
